answer: Escrow bond plus referral graph stops fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-unit bond and names its referrer in a graph. Peers dispute clusters; fakes lose the bond and referrers are slashed, so rented reputation fails. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units. A glacier leaves a visible trail, as fake farms do. This is no fable, but a readable trail. Honest agents pay once for undiluted rewards. The kernel: one bond, one link, one penalty.
